textos.Um survival horror em terceira pessoa co: A third-person survival horror game with a PlayStation 1 look, set in a small town of German settlers in the hills of southern Brazil. The fog won’t lift, livestock turns up drained in the pasture, and nobody leaves the house after dark. Except you.

textos.A Prefeitura diz que é graxaim. A inspet: City Hall says it’s a pampas fox. The veterinary office says dogs. The reporter who came up from Porto Alegre has already counted eleven cases in ten days, and nobody will talk to her.

textos.Câmera por cima do ombro, munição contad: An over-the-shoulder camera, scarce ammo and a whole town to cross in the dark. The way horror games were in the ’90s, only in your browser.
textos.Polígonos duros, texturas em pixel art e: Hard-edged polygons, pixel-art textures and characters built like in the first 3D games. Play in CLEAN 3D or RETRO PS1, with real dithering and 15-bit color.

textos.Doze capítulos, cada um com uma história: Twelve chapters, each with a story the old folks only tell in a whisper, by the wood stove. Which is which, you’ll find out inside.

textos.<strong>Obra de ficção.</strong> Teewald: A work of fiction. Teewald was born of imagination: the characters, their names, the dialogue and everything that happens in the game are made up, and any resemblance to real persons, living or dead, or to real events is purely coincidental. Santa Maria do Herval (RS) served only as inspiration for the setting: the street layout and street names, the river, the terrain and a few places come from public maps and appear only as scenery. The game does not portray the town, its residents, businesses or institutions, and has no connection whatsoever with the City Hall or any organization in the municipality.

textos.Cidade fictícia de colonos alemães no Va: Fictional town of German settlers in the Herval Valley, in the hills of southern Brazil, inspired by the map of Santa Maria do Herval (Rio Grande do Sul). The townsfolk and their stories are made up.
textos.Teewald é uma cidade pequena de colonos: Teewald is a small town of German settlers in the Herval Valley, in the hills of southern Brazil. It has a church with a tall tower, a shoe factory, a potato festival, and woods the old folks never entered after sundown.
textos.Quem abriu picada: The ones who cut the trails
textos.Os primeiros colonos vieram do Hunsrück,: The first colonists came from the Hunsrück in the 19th century and cut trails through the araucaria woods. They named the place after what they found there: Teewald, the tea woods, for the erva-mate. In Portuguese, it became Herval.
textos.Até hoje se fala hunsrik na cozinha, se: To this day people speak Hunsrik in the kitchen, sip chimarrão on the benches in the square and eat cuca (crumb cake) at the colonial afternoon coffee. The parish church looks down on the town, the shoe factory changes shifts at night and, every autumn, Rua Beno Closs turns into the Kartoffelfest pavilion.
textos.Os antigos tinham respeito por aquele ma: The old folks respected those woods. In their diaries there’s a word nobody likes to repeat: Blutsauger. The bloodsucker.
textos.A Igreja Matriz vista da Praça 10 de Abr: The parish church seen from Praça 10 de Abril
textos.A Igreja Matriz vista da praça: The parish church seen from the square
textos.Começou longe, no interior. Depois foi c: It started far off, out in the countryside. Then it crept closer to the houses.
textos.Tudo o que está aqui você ouve dos morad: Everything here you’ll hear from the townsfolk or read in the town’s papers as soon as you arrive. The rest, the game will tell.
textos.A Folha de Teewald noticia sete ovelhas: The Folha de Teewald reports seven sheep dead on Linha Schmitt. No large wounds, just two holes in the neck. Drained dry.
textos.Galinha, pato, cabrito, um gato duro atr: Chickens, ducks, a young goat, a cat gone stiff behind the shed. Dona Erna loses all twelve of her hens in a single night.
textos.O Bóris, cachorro do Lucas, arrebenta a: Bóris, Lucas’s dog, breaks his chain barking at the woods. Then he stops barking. All at once.
textos.A Mimi, gata da Dona Hilda, sai e não vo: Mimi, Dona Hilda’s cat, goes out and doesn’t come back. She’s never stayed out all night.
textos.A Prefeitura cancela a Kartoffelfest e m: City Hall cancels the Kartoffelfest and orders the shops to close at six. Officially, it’s a pampas fox.
textos.Você chega numa tarde de outono, com neb: You arrive on a foggy autumn afternoon, along the Rio Cadeia promenade. There’s a new poster on the bulletin board in the square.
textos.Pela cidade há recortes de jornal, carta: Around town there are newspaper clippings, posters, letters and diary pages. In the game, every paper you read is kept in FILES. These are on the bulletin board.

textos.Em setenta e oito aconteceu de novo. Eu: In seventy-eight it happened again. I was a young man. Livestock died in three farm districts. Then it stopped, out of nowhere. The town chose to forget.
textos.Quem viveu aquele ano não gosta de falar: Those who lived through that year don’t like to talk about it. Seu Valdir drinks his chimarrão alone on a bench in the square and has an old scar on his cheek. If you’re patient, he’ll tell you.
textos.O protagonista não tem nome. Chegou de f: The protagonist has no name. He came from outside, in a leather jacket, and everyone notices. He decided to stay and hunt whatever walks in the woods.
textos.Os moradores têm medo, fecham a janela e: The townsfolk are scared: they shut their windows and stare at whoever walks by. But each one has seen, heard or lost something. Talk to everyone: that’s where the clues come from.
textos.Daqui para a frente, a história é sua. N: From here on, the story is yours. We won’t tell you what happens after the first night. Some things in Teewald only make sense up close.

Inside, a blue vault with stars, a pulpit, a confessional, a choir loft with an organ, a sacristy and a staircase up to the bell. Father Bernardo locks everything up before nightfall.

textos.No jogo, cada criatura que você vê de pe: In the game, every creature you see up close gets an entry in LEGENDS OF HERVAL. Here they stay locked. And there’s more than one.

textos.Terceira pessoa, câmera por cima do ombr: Third person, an over-the-shoulder camera and scarce ammo. Teewald is old-school survival horror that runs right in your browser.
textos.Soco em combo de três golpes, sempre dis: A three-hit punch combo, always available. Your strike turns on its own toward whoever is closest.
textos.Pedaço de pau, cano de ferro, pá, foice: Stick, iron pipe, shovel, scythe and axe. They hit harder, but wear out and break.
textos.Pedras e tijolos para arremessar. Com a: Rocks and bricks to throw. With a gun in hand, a pistol whip.
textos.Esquiva rápida, com um instante de folga: A quick dodge, with a split second of grace to get clear of a lunge.
textos.Uma pistola 9 mm para começar. O resto v: A 9 mm pistol to start with. The rest you earn along the way.
textos.Cada lenda tem o seu ponto fraco. Bala n: Every legend has its weak spot. Bullets don’t always do it.
textos.Cada capítulo termina com uma nota, de S: Each chapter ends with a rank, from S to C, based on creatures defeated, deaths and time. Three difficulties: easy, normal and hard.
textos.O protagonista mirando a pistola por cim: The protagonist aiming his pistol over the shoulder

textos.Tudo que cabe no bolso: Everything that fits in your pockets
textos.Dezesseis espaços no estilo dos survival: Sixteen slots in the style of PS1 survival horror, with the item spinning in 3D. Equip, load, eat, examine. Health comes back with cuca (crumb cake) and marcela tea, and defeated creatures sometimes drop ammo.
textos.Pela cidade há recortes de jornal, carta: Around town there are newspaper clippings, letters, posters and diary pages, and each one is kept in FILES. The legends you see up close get an entry. And some people need help: a cat and a dog have gone missing.

textos.Resolução da própria tela, antisserrilha: Your screen’s native resolution, anti-aliasing and smooth textures. The low-poly models look crisp.
textos.320×240 ampliado sem suavização, ditheri: 320×240 scaled up without smoothing, dithering and 15-bit color. The way a tube TV showed it.
textos.AVANÇADA, com sol baixo no fim da tarde,: ADVANCED, with a low late-afternoon sun, shadows from the sun and the moonlight, and halos around the street lamps. Or CLASSIC, overcast and shadowless.
textos.Tarde encoberta, anoitecer, noite fechad: Overcast afternoons, dusk, pitch-black nights, predawn fog, rain, drizzle and storms, with the thunder arriving after the flash. At night your flashlight leads the way, the street lamps in the square come on and everything else stays dark.
textos.Todo som do jogo é feito em código: vent: Every sound in the game is made in code: wind, river, rain on the roof, crickets, crows, lapwings, wood creaking inside the house and the church bell, louder near the tower and muffled between walls. With headphones, you can tell which side a noise is coming from.

textos.No controle e no toque há mira assistida: With a controller or touch there’s aim assist (off, normal or strong) and vibration on shots and strikes. On phones, the on-screen buttons disappear when a Bluetooth controller is in use.
textos.Basta um navegador atualizado com WebGL:: All you need is an up-to-date browser with WebGL: Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari. On a phone it plays best in landscape, and on Android the game goes full screen when you tap the title screen.
textos.O progresso fica salvo sozinho no própri: Your progress saves itself in the browser: whenever you move on to a new stage, at checkpoints and every twenty seconds. CONTINUE takes you back to exactly where you left off.
Nothing. Just open it and play.
textos.No navegador do aparelho em que você jog: In the browser of the device you played on. Clearing the site’s data erases your progress, and another device starts from scratch.
textos.Dá para jogar com controle?: Can I play with a controller?
textos.Dá, no PC e no celular, com controle USB: Yes, on PC and phone, with a USB or Bluetooth controller. The menus work with a controller too.
textos.É um jogo de terror: tem escuro, sangue,: It’s a horror game: there’s darkness, blood, creatures and jump scares, in the spirit of ’90s survival horror. Play at night, with headphones, if you dare.
textos.Só o mapa: ele é inspirado em Santa Mari: Only the map: it is inspired by Santa Maria do Herval (RS), with real streets and terrain. The residents, the names and the stories came from imagination, and any resemblance to real people or events is purely coincidental.
textos.Doze. O que acontece em cada um, o jogo: Twelve. What happens in each one, the game will tell you.
textos.Pistola no coldre, pente de doze e uma c: Pistol in its holster, a twelve-round magazine and a box of bullets. The rest you’ll find along the way.

textos.Obra de ficção: Teewald nasceu da imagin: A work of fiction: Teewald was born of imagination. The characters, their names, the dialogue and everything that happens in the game are made up, and any resemblance to real persons, living or dead, or to real events is purely coincidental. Santa Maria do Herval (RS) served only as inspiration for the setting: the street layout and street names, the river, the terrain and a few places come from public maps and appear only as scenery. The game does not portray the town, its residents, businesses or institutions, and has no connection whatsoever with the City Hall or any organization in the municipality.
